snippet.title: Pioneer PBS
snippet.description:
Pioneer PBS is a regional public television network in Minnesota, primarily serving the southwest and west-central portions of the state Minnesota, northwestern Iowa, eastern South Dakota, southwestern North Dakota and beyond.

For 60 years Pioneer PBS has served its rural audience through a mix of local and national programs rich in cultural heritage, diversity and educational opportunities.

Pioneer PBS is based in Granite Falls, Minnesota. It's original operations, based in Appleton, Minnesota, began in February of 1966, doing business as West Central Minnesota Educational Television Company.

Pioneer PBS is an award-winning, viewer-supported television station dedicated to sharing local stories of the region with the world.  

For more information visit https://www.pioneer.org.
Want to donate or support Pioneer PBS visit: https://bit.ly/3JHTZUn

snippet.title: WWII Through Their Eyes
snippet.description:
A channel dedicated to bringing the most pivotal moments of World War II back to life, told not through dry textbooks, but through the voices of those who lived it.

Here, every video is crafted as a unique blend of documentary storytelling and cinematic reconstruction. You will hear the imagined voices of soldiers, commanders, and civilians — ordinary people caught in extraordinary times — narrating their experiences from the frontlines and beyond. From the frozen hell of Stalingrad to the beaches of Normandy, from the burning skies over London to the desperate last days in Berlin, each story reveals the raw human struggle behind history’s most destructive war.

Our mission is simple: to make history personal, emotional, and unforgettable. These aren’t just battles and dates — they are stories of courage, fear, sacrifice, and survival.

Subscribe and step into the past — to see WWII not from the outside, but through their eyes.

snippet.title: Vestiges of History
snippet.description:
Vestiges of History is a YouTube channel that explores and shares the story of people through the objects they left behind. 

The goals of the channel are: 
Make History more accessible and entertaining.
Teach research skills.
Tell the best and truest version of the human experience.
Share untold stories.
Give voice to the voiceless.
Provide some historical narrative parity.
Feed an insatiable case of curiosity.
Live a storied life. 

DISCLAIMER: For entertainment purposes only. Although we work hard to verify our sources and authenticate our storytelling, we do not guarantee the accuracy of any statements made. All rights reserved. All objects appearing in this video are used with permission.
